profile.reading: Brand first then strength then galenic form then pack, e.g. AMOCLAN 8.1 ENF 500/62.5MG SACHET B/14. Strengths are written with comma decimals, mixed units and slashes: 1G/125MG, 500/62.5MG, 0,2G/0,5G/100ML, 0,1%, 100UI/ML. Forms and containers are heavily abbreviated in fixed order: CP PELLI/SEC/EFFERV/DISP, GLES/GELS, SP/SUSP BUV, SOL, GTTES, COLLYRE, INJ/AMP, SUPP, PDE/CREME/GEL, FL/T. Pack is B/xx, BT, BOITE DE STYLOS and count decides size; same brand is told apart by strength value, form/coating, population ADULTES/AD/ENF/BEBE and volume.
